topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that my friend hasn’t been honest about their job. It wasn’t a surprise that left me reeling; rather, it settled in quietly, like the understanding that sometimes comes with watching a friend grow differently from you. We all carry parts of ourselves that we choose to share or withhold, and I’ve come to see this as another layer in the intricate tapestry of our relationships. Instead of confronting them with anger, I found myself reflecting on the countless times we’ve laughed together, the way we supported each other through challenging times. There’s a lot more to this friendship than one piece of information. I’ll speak to them soon, because understanding often begins with a conversation.
